title: Port 3MF import (zip container, units, textures)
scope: 3MF package reading including unit scaling, components/build transforms and packed textures, with the original's archive and decompression limits.
acceptance: Generated and adversarial 3MF corpus (zip bombs, bad paths, missing parts, unit variants) compares original against Rust on geometry, units, refusals and limits.
The inflate/zip implementation is pure Rust and passes the P35 purity audit; the choice is a recorded decision, not an assumption.
open_items: Deflate/zip: decide own implementation versus an audited pure-Rust crate before coding.
